label: Gödel 1970: distinct positivity closure axioms
summary: GoedelVariantHOML1.thy, Ax1: "⌊P φ ❙∧ P ψ ❙⊃ P (φ ❙. ψ)⌋": Gödel's conjunction axiom and the closure axiom for necessary inclusion constrain different operations. The conjunction axiom does not restrict the necessary-inclusion axiom. A further account of their interaction would require a common derivation or an explicit implication with its premises.
